description: A small brown play-kitchen cabinet with two silver knobs sits on the table, and inside its open shelf are several clear plastic food containers with gray latches. The right hand reaches into the shelf, grasps a clear container, pulls it out and sets it on the tabletop to the right, then repeats this several times—unstacking and removing more containers from the shelf and placing them together in a growing cluster while the left hand stays near the front edge of the table without touching the containers.
